LEGEND.PARAGRAPH_3: But beyond the legends, one truth remains:
LEGEND.PARAGRAPH_3_1: Rtanj nurtures some of Europe"s most powerful medicinal herbs.
LEGEND.PARAGRAPH_3_2: The mountain"s unique microclimate, mineral-rich soil, and altitude create conditions that concentrate the bioactive compounds in every plant that grows on its slopes.

HOWTO.TITLE: THE RITUAL
HOWTO.SUBTITLE: Just 30 seconds from powder to wellness. Simple, elegant, effective.
HOWTO.STEP_1_DESC: Add 220ml of water. Warm water of 50 °C temperature max or chilled water works beautifully.
HOWTO.STEP_2_DESC: Pour 25g of Immunasina Rtanj Latte Wild or other product powder into your glass or shaker bottle.
HOWTO.STEP_3_DESC: Blend or shake vigorously for 30 seconds until smooth and creamy. The powder dissolves completely.
HOWTO.STEP_4_DESC: Pour into your favorite cup and enjoy immediately. No straining needed. Pure functional nutrition.
HOWTO.FOOTER_2: For extra creaminess, use blender. For on-the-go, use a shaker bottle — the 30-second shake is all you need.

SCIENCE.RESEARCH_INTRO: Selected research on our ingredients and production approach. These publications study ingredients or processes, not finished Immunasina products; the type of evidence and its limits are noted for each paper.

DONKEY_MILK.SUMMARY: Reviews donkey milk’s nutrients and research into antioxidant, antimicrobial and immune-related activity. It provides an overview of potential applications and production challenges, rather than a clinical trial demonstrating benefits of an Immunasina drink.

SATUREJA.SUMMARY: Examines savory extracts and essential oils using chemical and enzyme assays. S. montana extracts showed antioxidant activity in laboratory tests. These findings do not demonstrate disease prevention or treatment in people, and concentrated extracts are not equivalent to a prepared beverage.

FIBER.SUMMARY: Combines prospective studies and randomized trials on carbohydrate quality. Higher dietary fiber intake was associated with lower mortality and several chronic disease risks; trials also found improvements in selected risk factors. The review excluded fiber-supplement trials, so its results should not be applied directly to an individual fortified drink.

FREEZE_DRYING.SUMMARY: Explains freezing, primary drying by sublimation and secondary drying, and how process settings influence food structure and physical quality. It supports understanding of freeze-drying technology, but does not establish the shelf life or nutrient retention of a specific product.
